name: Attorney fee caps and contingency-fee rules, by state and federal program
description: Legal limits on what a lawyer may charge, by program and jurisdiction: workers' compensation in every US state and DC, Social Security (SSDI and SSI), the Federal Tort Claims Act, VA benefits, Longshore, FECA and black lung, plus medical-malpractice and general contingency-fee rules in the states covered. Each record gives the cap type, percent, dollar cap or sliding-scale tiers, what the percent applies to and who approves the fee, and cites the statute, rule or agency page with an exact quote and the date read (primary sources only). A lookup, not a fee calculator.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Attorney fee caps and contingency-fee rules, by state and federal program (Version 3.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23969434

distribution.name: fees.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: fees.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: fees-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in fees-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to fees.csv on id.

recordSet.name: fees
recordSet.description: The records of Attorney fee caps and contingency-fee rules, by state and federal program, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code, DC, US (federal), ABA, or PLATFORM:<name>

field.name: program
field.description: workers-comp, med-mal, contingency-general, ssdi-ssi, ftca, va, longshore or other

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: capType
field.description: percent, dollar, lesser-of, sliding-scale, approval-required, reasonableness-only or unknown

field.name: approval
field.description: Who approves the fee: agency, judge, none or unknown

field.name: citation
field.description: The statute, rule or regulation cited

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
